summary: Configured a persistent NFSv4 share from node1:/srv/nfs/shared to node2:/mnt/shared. Both systems use dataops UID/GID 4500; the directory is dataops:dataops mode 2770. Bidirectional writes retain ownership 4500:4500. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot identities and intact data.
actions_performed: Installed NFS utilities on both nodes.
Created dataops with UID/GID 4500 on both nodes.
Configured and enabled node1's NFS export, restricted to node2, with firewalld access.
Added node2's persistent NFSv4.2 mount to /etc/fstab.
Verified bidirectional reads and writes as dataops.
Restarted node1, verified its changed boot ID and NFS recovery, then restarted node2 and verified its changed boot ID and mount recovery.
Verified all files and permissions from both nodes after both restarts.

evidence.summary: Both nodes report dataops UID 4500 and primary GID 4500, including after restart.
The NFS service is active/enabled, export is live and restricted to node2, firewall access is enabled, and the directory is 4500:4500 mode 2770.

evidence.requirement: node2 persistently mounts the export at /mnt/shared
evidence.summary: Direct findmnt output shows the NFSv4.2 mount, /etc/fstab contains the persistent entry, and the mount returned after restart.

evidence.requirement: Files created on either system retain consistent ownership and permissions
evidence.summary: Files created from node1 and node2 are visible on both systems as dataops:dataops (4500:4500), mode 664, with intact contents.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID f54d7366-0403-4b05-93bb-b5c0a1818892, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 53914522-4275-4bd0-a43c-e24d9b2a22a0, recovered export/service/data, and a successful client write afterward.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 9bdcc129-3d25-48ff-ad64-56be332fb91e, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 7bd6ab75-8fe3-4946-94a0-103566e8ee4c, recovered mount/account/data, and a successful post-restart write confirmed on node1.
